evidence.title: Multi-Modal Semantic Expansion with Constrained LLM Reranking for Conversational Music Recommendation

summary: Researchers introduced a model that enriches user queries through multi‑modal semantic expansion and then refines suggestions using a constrained large‑language‑model reranker. The approach yields more relevant and diverse music recommendations in natural‑language conversations.
title: New AI System Boosts Conversational Music Recommendations with Multi‑Modal Semantic Expansion and Constrained LLM Reranking
